name: lemma
description: Lemma — a self-hosted mathematical engineering laboratory

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @lemma/server" "npm run dev -w @lemma/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lemma/web && npm run build -w @lemma/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/content && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server && tsc --noEmit -p packages/web
